content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face a daunting challenge: setting up a reliable payment gateway for their products without relying on Stripe or PayPal. This infrastructure hurdle can be crippling, but there's a solution that bypasses these limitations altogether. By leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can take control of their sales process and start [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-art-without-paypal-explained-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]] their digital products with ease. The key lies in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-digital-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how-3|Cloudflare Workers]]-pages-free-works-7|deploying]] a crypto payment gateway that integrates seamlessly with their online store, enabling them to receive payments in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin or Ethereum.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-3. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today: Crypto payment

The first step towards setting up a crypto payment gateway is to choose a suitable platform that supports cryptocurrency transactions. For digital creators in Kenya, this means selecting a platform that can handle payments in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin or Ethereum. With the right platform in place, creators can start configuring their payment gateway, setting up their store, and loading their digital products. This process can be completed within a matter of hours, allowing creators to start selling their products quickly and efficiently.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

A minimum viable stack for crypto payments consists of a few essential components: a hosting platform, a backend logic handler, and a payment processor. For hosting, platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages offer free and reliable options. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle payment verification and product delivery. Finally, a payment processor like NOWPayments enables creators to receive cryptocurrency payments with a low fee of 0.5%. With these components in place, creators can establish a functional payment gateway that supports crypto transactions.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

When setting up a crypto payment gateway, it's essential to focus on the critical components that enable transactions. This means skipping unnecessary steps and configurations that don't directly impact the payment process. By prioritizing the essential elements, creators can streamline their setup process and get their payment gateway up and running quickly. This approach also helps to minimize potential errors and ensures that the payment gateway functions as intended.
Start selling digital products with crypto payments today.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once the payment gateway is set up, the next step is to test it with a live transaction. This involves creating a test product, setting a price in cryptocurrency, and completing a purchase using the payment gateway. By verifying that the payment gateway functions correctly, creators can ensure that their customers can purchase their digital products seamlessly. With the first transaction live, creators can refine their setup, optimize their store, and start promoting their products to potential customers.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, digital creators in Kenya can take concrete steps to establish their crypto payment gateway. This includes selecting a hosting platform, configuring backend logic, and integrating a payment processor like NOWPayments. By following a structured approach, creators can set up a functional payment gateway that supports crypto transactions and start selling their digital products quickly. With the right infrastructure in place, creators can focus on promoting their products and growing their customer base.
Is there any crypto payment gateway?

The fastest way to set up a crypto payment gateway is to leverage a sovereign commerce infrastructure that bypasses traditional payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. By using a platform like NOWPayments, creators can receive cryptocurrency payments with a low fee of 0.5% and start selling their digital products quickly.
Bypass Stripe and PayPal with sovereign commerce infrastructure.

This kit includes all the necessary tools and documentation to establish a functional payment gateway and start selling digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a crypto payment gateway, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments, set up your store and load your digital products, and test your payment gateway with a live transaction. By following these steps, creators can establish a functional payment gateway that supports crypto transactions and start selling their digital products quickly.
